summary: Stdcall 3DNow! routine that computes two packed output pairs as affine weighted sums over an 8-pair coefficient table a3, driven by three weight scalars read from a2 (two packed in a2[0], the third as the low dword of a2[1]). a1[0] = w0*a3[0] + w1*a3[2] + w2*a3[4] + a3[6]; a1[1] = w0*a3[1] + w1*a3[3] + w2*a3[5] + a3[7], where each a3[n] is a packed pair of floats and the weights are broadcast across both lanes. Emits _m_femms() on entry and again before returning the destination pointer a1. No branches or calls.

local_names.a2: input pair array holding the three weights (w0,w1 in a2[0], w2 = a2[1] low dword)
local_names.a3: coefficient table of eight packed pairs a3[0..7]
local_names.v4: weight w0 broadcast to both lanes (punpckldq of a2[0])
local_names.v6: weight w1 broadcast to both lanes (punpckhdq of a2[0])
local_names.v7: weight w2 broadcast to both lanes (punpckldq of v5)
local_names.v8: second output pair, pfadd(pfadd(pfmul(v4,a3[1]), a3[7]), pfadd(pfmul(v6,a3[3]), pfmul(v7,a3[5])))

operations.description: Execute _m_femms() on entry to clear 3DNow!/MMX state before the packed math.
Load and broadcast the first weight: v4 = punpckldq(a2->m64_u64, a2->m64_u64) duplicates the low float of a2[0] into both lanes.
Load the third weight scalar v5 = cvtsi32_si64(a2[1].m64_u32[0]) from the low dword of the second input slot.
Load and broadcast the second weight: v6 = punpckhdq(a2->m64_u64, a2->m64_u64) duplicates the high float of a2[0] into both lanes.
Broadcast the third weight v7 = punpckldq(v5, v5) so both lanes carry w2.
Compute second output pair v8 = pfadd(pfadd(pfmul(v4, a3[1]), a3[7]), pfadd(pfmul(v6, a3[3]), pfmul(v7, a3[5]))): w0*a3[1] + a3[7] + w1*a3[3] + w2*a3[5].
Write first output pair a1->m64_u64 = pfadd(pfadd(pfmul(v4, a3[0]), a3[6]), pfadd(pfmul(v6, a3[2]), pfmul(v7, a3[4]))): w0*a3[0] + a3[6] + w1*a3[2] + w2*a3[4] into the low output slot at this+0x0.
Write second output pair a1[1].m64_u64 = v8 into the high output slot at this+0x8.
Execute _m_femms() before returning to clear 3DNow!/MMX state.
